# Structural paths (docs/GOVERNANCE.md step 2).
#
# A path listed here never lands on `main` through the session debrief. The
# debrief refuses to commit it there and offers a feature branch instead,
# which /ship turns into a pull request. This applies to every operator.
#
# Syntax, one entry per line:
#   pattern      shell glob matched against the whole repo-relative path;
#                `*` also matches `/`, so `skills/*` covers every depth.
#   !pattern     exception: a path matching it is never structural, even if a
#                pattern would catch it. Exceptions win wherever they sit.
#   # comment    ignored, as are blank lines.
#
# The file ships inert: nothing below is active until you uncomment or add a
# line. The block below is the recommended starting point once you adopt
# step 2: the skills suite, the scripts, the git plumbing, and the protected
# files, that is the few CLAUDE.md files deciding how every agent behaves.
# Area CLAUDE.md files (areas/<name>/CLAUDE.md) are deliberately absent: they
# describe a folder and change often, so they keep landing on `main` through
# the debrief after approval in chat. Add the system files of your own brain.
#
# !skills/_improvements/friction-log.md
# skills/*
# scripts/*
# githooks/*
# .github/*
# CLAUDE.md
# memory/CLAUDE.md
# daily-log/CLAUDE.md
# operators/CLAUDE.md
